title: 第7章 武馆梅花拳第8章 抽卡变强
content_zh:
路沉只觉得心口一烫，几乎要笑出声来。
总算解锁了武学卡池。
也就在这时，他注意到越来越多的弟子走进了武馆大院。
这些年轻弟子，衣着体面，能在武馆习武的，自然都是些殷实人家的子弟，更有几个格外扎眼的，锦袍绣袄，身后跟着小厮丫鬟，一看便知是城里的富贵人家。
这些人互相寒暄说笑，目光扫过坐在石阶上的路沉时，见他一身脏兮兮的旧棉袄，只当是新来的仆人，连正眼都未多给。
等弟子都来齐了，邓彦这才打着哈欠从房间里出来。
“师父安好。”院中弟子们齐声问好。
“嗯。”
邓彦懒洋洋地点了点头，瞥了一眼站在院角的路沉。
回头对屋门口候着的刘奇道
“今天来的新弟子，你负责教他。”
“是，老爷。”刘奇道。
邓彦又交代了几句，便又转身回了屋子。
而刘奇走到路沉面前，递给他几个沉甸甸的沙袋
“新来的，把这些绑在腿上，手臂和腰上。”
路沉依言照做。
粗布缝制的袋子摸着就知道分量不轻，里头装的怕是实打实的铁砂。
路沉绑在身上，只觉得四肢顿时沉重了许多。
院中弟子也都熟练地在腿上绑好沙袋，摆开马步架势。
路沉有样学样。

只是那些沙袋少说也有十来斤重。
他刚蹲下片刻，就觉双腿发颤。
“刘奇兄弟，这蹲马步是练什么，不是应该先学拳法招式吗。”
路沉有点疑惑问道。
刘奇虽只是个杂役，但在武馆待得年头久了，耳濡目染也懂了不少门道。
他见路沉问得诚恳，便细细道来
“武者有两大境界，一是外劲，二是内劲。
外劲练的是筋骨皮肉，讲究打熬力气，如铁匠打铁，千锤百炼。内劲练的是一口真气，讲究呼吸吐纳。
外劲练到高深处，一拳能开碑裂石。内劲练成，则能隔空伤敌。”
刘奇指了指路沉绑着沙袋的双腿
“这扎马步，是外劲修炼的根基。下盘稳了，发力才有根。
咱们武馆是上午练基本功，下午练拳法。
不过要是等你学了拳法，你想上午练拳，下午练功也行，随你。”
路沉想起那日从青河门来的，替李天瑞出头的师姐。
content_en:
Lu Chen felt his heart heat up and almost laughed out loud.
Finally unlocked the martial arts card pool.
It was at this time that he noticed more and more disciples walking into the martial arts courtyard.
These young disciples, well-dressed and able to practice martial arts in the martial arts hall, are naturally the children of wealthy families, and there are a few that are particularly eye-catching, wearing brocade robes and embroidered coats, followed by servants and maids, and you can tell at a glance that they are wealthy families in the city.
These people were chatting and joking with each other. When their eyes glanced at Lu Shen who was sitting on the stone steps, they saw that he was wearing a dirty old cotton-padded jacket. They just thought he was a new servant and didn't even pay attention to him.
When all the disciples arrived, Deng Yan came out of the room with a yawn.
"How are you, Master?" The disciples in the courtyard greeted him in unison.
"Yeah."
Deng Yan nodded lazily and glanced at Lu Shen, who was standing in the corner of the courtyard.
He turned back to Liu Qida, who was waiting at the door of the house.
"The new disciple is here today, you are responsible for teaching him."
"Yes, sir." Liu Qi said.
Deng Yan explained a few more words, then turned and returned to the house.
Liu Qi walked up to Lu Chen and handed him a few heavy sandbags.
"New guy, tie these on your legs, arms and waist."
Lu Chen did as he was told.
The bag sewn from coarse cloth is heavy enough to touch, and it is probably filled with solid iron sand.
Lu Chen was tied to his body, and his limbs suddenly felt much heavier.
The disciples in the courtyard also skillfully tied sandbags on their legs and got into a horse stance.
Lu Shen has learned from others.
But those sandbags weighed at least ten kilograms.
As soon as he squatted down for a moment, he felt his legs trembling.
"Brother Liu Qi, what is this squatting horse stance for? Shouldn't you learn boxing moves first?"
Lu Chen asked a little confused.
Although Liu Qi is just a handyman, he has been in the martial arts school for a long time and has learned a lot about it.
Seeing that Lu Chen asked sincerely, he asked in detail
"A warrior has two realms, one is external strength, and the other is internal strength.
External strength trains the muscles, bones, skin and flesh, and emphasizes hard work, just like a blacksmith forging iron through repeated hammering. Nei Jin training is about breathing in and out.
The external strength has been practiced to such a high level that one punch can open monuments and crack rocks. Once the inner strength is developed, one can injure the enemy from a distance. "
Liu Qi pointed at Lu Shen's legs, which were tied with sandbags.
"This Zha Ma Step is the foundation of external strength training. Only when the lower body is stable can the strength be rooted.
In our martial arts studio, we practice basic skills in the morning and boxing techniques in the afternoon.
But if you have learned boxing, you can practice boxing in the morning or in the afternoon, it’s up to you. "
Lu Chen thought of the senior sister who came from Qinghe Gate that day to stand up for Li Tianrui.
